thread.zh: 旧神的光环笼罩赛场太久。长久以来那一道不败金身，困住了无数人的期待，但时代不会永远停在原地，这是属于我们最强的一次对决，全员状态拉满，锋芒尽数出鞘，实力与底气全都就位。不是凭空期待奇迹，是日复一日的沉淀，让我们拥有了正面击碎神话的底气。传奇值得尊重，但王座从来不会永远固定属于谁。积攒了十几年的期待与不甘，全部落在这场宿命对决。这一回，不败金身终于到了落幕的时候，这次一定会拿下，书写全新的历史篇章！
thread.en: The aura of the old god has shrouded the stage for too long. For ages, that invincible golden body has trapped the expectations of countless people, but the era won't stay in one place forever. This is the strongest matchup we've ever had; everyone is at peak form, blades are drawn, and both skill and confidence are ready. We aren't just hoping for a miracle out of thin air; it's the day-to-day grind that gives us the confidence to shatter the myth head-on. Legends deserve respect, but the throne never belongs to anyone forever. All the expectations and frustrations accumulated over a decade fall upon this fated duel. This time, the invincible golden body is finally set to fall. We will win this, and write a brand new chapter in history!
